link.reason: The host finding a copy of Alien Conspiracy signed by Chris Evans is a separate document story. No story below covers it.

candidates.title: Light over the mesa, green light, missing time and Apache helicopters
candidates.place_text: Aztec crash site mesa, New Mexico
candidates.quote: Right after we said it was a 90 degree turn [snorts] and we're uh you know and we're walking back down to the rest of the group and uh it it was instantly over us.

link.reason: This is an unnamed camper's own encounter on the mesa: a light, missing time and helicopters. It is a different witness from the whistling UFO sighting near Aztec.

candidates.title: Strange lights over the San Juan coal mine
candidates.place_text: San Juan coal mine, New Mexico
candidates.quote: I also spoke to an Aztec local who has seen strange lights darting above the San Juan coal mine right by where he worked

link.reason: The lights over the San Juan coal mine are a local man's own sighting. It is distinct from the other Aztec-area sightings below.

candidates.title: Black SUVs, helicopters and a 30 ft hole near the crash site
candidates.quote: we found came across a hole and it was about 30 ft deep, 30 ft in diameter, kind of like a circular hole.

link.reason: Brett Lanner describes his own 1999 experience at Hart Canyon: black SUVs, helicopters and a 30 ft hole. The nearest story is Scott Ramsay's account of helicopters following researchers in the 1980s, which is a different witness and a different incident.

candidates.title: Cattle mutilations on the Archuleta Ranch
candidates.quote: Uh the ears and eyes were still intact, but uh the other was just looked like a surgeon had taken it off.

link.reason: An unnamed Aztec-area resident tells the same surgical-looking animal mutilation with the same 'like a surgeon had taken it off' description.
link.difference: Places it on the Archuleta Ranch and says the ears and eyes were left intact, but does not mention the lack of blood.

candidates.title: Cigar-shaped craft near Turtle Mountain
candidates.place_text: Turtle Mountain, on the road from Cuba, New Mexico
candidates.quote: but there was this, it looked like a cigar.

link.reason: Christa's sighting of a cigar-shaped craft near Turtle Mountain, New Mexico, is not any story below. The other cigar-shaped sightings are in Sweden, Brazil and the Pacific.

candidates.title: Marble from crash site tests about 40% iridium by XRF
candidates.quote: they got a very anomalous result. In fact, they got back an extremely high percentage of aridium, close to 40%.

link.reason: The XRF test that found about 40% iridium is a separate event from the 1999 finding of the polished marble. The marble story covers only the discovery, not the analysis.

candidates.title: Lab retest of the marble finds no iridium
candidates.quote: So I can already tell like this is going to be nowhere near dense enough for a heavy metal like uh aridium.

link.reason: This is the same marble and the same question of what it is made of as telling 4, but Zodakis's lab retest finds no iridium, so the two claims contradict each other.
link.difference: The lab retest finds the marble far too light to be a heavy metal and detects no iridium, against the roughly 40% reported in telling 4.

candidates.title: Skeptic Carl Pflock's only visit to the crash site
candidates.quote: The only skeptic that has ever been here was Carl Flock. That's because I drove him out here and walked him around and he lived two hours away.

link.reason: Scott Ramsay's account of taking skeptic Carl Pflock to the crash site matches no story below. The nearest Aztec stories are about helicopters, the marble and the craft's removal.

candidates.title: Carl Pflock broke into a congressman's office and took Aztec evidence
candidates.quote: He also said that that congressman's office was broken into by none other than Carl Flock.

link.reason: The claim that Carl Pflock broke into a congressman's office and took Aztec evidence is a different event from his visit to the site in telling 6, and no story below covers it.
